verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (now Virtual Mail under LegalZoom) publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 YAML file for its public API, explicitly intended for import into Postman, Swagger UI, or code generators. It also serves a machine-readable MCP tool catalog as a second machine surface. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and accurate; changelog and versioning-policy documentation for the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The OpenAPI 3.1 specification is available as a YAML file for import into tools like Postman, Swagger UI, or code generators.
A machine-readable MCP tool catalog is served live at the API origin under /v2/.
